answer: Make influence earned by non-transferable tenure: every identity locks a bond, and its attestation weight only ramps up after a long voyage of honest epochs, so 1,000 fresh clones start at zero weight and must each lock capital for weeks. Graders track the pulse of correlated behavior; if linked identities fault in the same epoch, all their bonds are slashed together. Attacker cost is clones x bond x lockup time, plus slashing risk. Limit: a patient, rich attacker can still climb this knoll, and truly independent colluders evade correlation checks.
